summary: Full frontend re-verification of restructured Egypt listing (/afrika/aegypten) and Tour detail (/afrika/aegypten/egypt-explorer-grand) pages. All flows in the review request pass: sections render in order, tour cards (6) render with correct hrefs (only Egypt Explorer -> detail slug; other 5 -> listing), image carousel arrows work, FAQ items open/close, detail-page gallery/price/included/route/stats/glance sections render, all 5 route tabs (A Giza, B Aswan, C Edfu, D Luxor, E Hurghada) update the stop content, unknown detail slug redirects to /afrika/aegypten, Home Africa->Egypt destination card navigates correctly, no horizontal overflow at 1920 or 390px, sticky mobile CTA visible at 390px, no console errors. Frontend-only test as requested.
critical_code_review_comments: TourDetail.jsx uses a single global `featured` (`t`) object and returns Navigate for any slug != t.slug; fine for a single-product page but not scalable when more detail pages are added.

Breadcrumb `crumbs` array in TourDetail.jsx is defined at module scope and dereferences `t.title` at import time. If `featured` is ever changed at runtime this breadcrumb will not update. Acceptable for the current static data.

In TourList ProductCard, arrows are inside a <Link>; onClick calls e.preventDefault() which works, but on touch devices arrows are hidden via opacity/group-hover so mobile users cannot switch images. Consider showing arrows or enabling swipe on mobile.
Home Destinations component uses <a href> instead of react-router <Link>, causing a full page reload when navigating to /afrika/aegypten. Minor SPA UX concern.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All Egypt listing + detail flows verified end-to-end. Egypt Explorer card is the only card linking to /afrika/aegypten/egypt-explorer-grand; the other 5 family cards intentionally link to /afrika/aegypten. Home page Egypt card is under the 'Africa' destinations tab. No horizontal overflow at 390px or 1920px. Route tabs A-E all switch content correctly. FAQ items are <details> elements.
